idea-plugin.name: JsonSql
idea-plugin.description:
Json Sql
Retrieve the desired data from JSON using SQL
And convert SQL to JSON again
Support import and export of Excel and CSV files
The supported SQL statements are：
  • select *、name、name as alias、name.surname(Multi layer query)
  • where =、!=、in、not in、>、>=、<、<=、between
  • like(_ and% escape with \\_ and \\%)、not like、is null、is not null
  • and、or、Nesting 'and' and 'or'
  • left、right、length、concat、if、ifnull、nullif、substr、substring、upper、lower、isnull、round functions
  • group by；sum、avg、max、min、count、group_concat、any_value、group_array functions
  • having
  • order by asc、desc、distinct
  • limit 1,2
Unsupported SQL statements include：
  • update、insert、delete
  • join
  • union
  • Special keywords such as 'result' and 'date' (should be accompanied by ``)
  • The key in JSON cannot contain '.' If there is, it will be converted to _NaN_ (SQL query only)
Some Examples：
  • select level.type.name t from arr where level.type.name in ('hello') order by t
  • select distinct name from a where name = 'hello' and (age >= 11 or level like '%\\%lin%')
  • select left(right(left(id,3),2), 1) a, count( left(right(left(id,3),2), 1)) b from t_user group by a


将json通过sql查出想要的数据
并把sql再转成json
支持excel、csv导入导出
支持的sql语句有：
  • select *、name、name as alias、name.surname（多层查询）
  • where =、!=、in、not in、>、>=、<、<=、between
  • like（_和%转义用\\_和\\%）、not like、is null、is not null
  • and、or、嵌套and和or
  • left、right、length、concat、if、ifnull、nullif、substr、substring、upper、lower、isnull、round等函数
  • group by；sum、avg、max、min、count、group_concat、any_value、group_array 等函数
  • having
  • order by asc、desc、distinct
  • limit 1,2
不支持的sql语句有：
  • update、insert、delete
  • 连表
  • union
  • 特殊的关键词如：result、date（要带上``）
  • json里的key不能含有'.'，有则会转成_NaN_（仅sql查询）
一些例子：
  • select level.type.name t from arr where level.type.name in ('hello') order by t
  • select distinct name from a where name = 'hello' and (age >= 11 or level like '%\\%lin%')
  • select left(right(left(id,3),2), 1) a, count( left(right(left(id,3),2), 1)) b from t_user group by a
